mutations.name: keep-mark-at-handover
mutations.why: message_end no longer takes the mark down: a quiet report after the handover reads as urgent
mutations.search: /\ marks' = IF Design = "handover" THEN marks \ {m} ELSE marks

mutations.name: quiet-report-armed
mutations.why: a progress report or note raises a mark (interruptFor called for any report), leaving the set of marks TypeOK allows
mutations.search: /\ turn = "running" /\ m \in Urgent /\ m \notin sentEver /\ m \notin armed

mutations.name: peek-ignores-marks
mutations.why: the peek says yes for any queued aside, as if every report were urgent

mutations.name: peek-stock-only
mutations.why: the bridge's peek never answers for our marks (stock's plain aside): an urgent message waits behind a running shell

mutations.name: subagent-turn-end-clears
mutations.why: the agent_end hook clears the marks for any agent: a subagent ending its turn takes the main agent's pending report down (the advisory of 19 Nov 2026)

mutations.name: subagent-message-end-unmarks
mutations.why: the message_end hook acts for any agent: a subagent's message with the same key takes the main agent's mark down
